observations.content: User provided a context-only packet for a later implementation turn: requirements state worker pi usage costs (including ephemeral/unsuccessful runs when valid) must be exposed to the parent orchestrator, persisted as role/run-identified session-ledger entries, included in branch totals including abandoned branches, safely ignore missing/malformed/non-finite/negative values, appear in status/footer UI, and receive focused tests for aggregation, invalid entries, handoff, and display.

The supplied observational-memory plan specifies a phased pi extension: Phase A short-term observer→branch-local ledger→deterministic compaction plus TUI; Phase B consolidator and durable project `.memory/` topic files. Worker subprocesses use bespoke `child_process.spawn` of recorded headless `pi -e agent/index.ts -p` sessions, with shared extension selected by `OM_WORKER=observer|consolidator`, rather than subagents.

Plan decisions include default-OFF per-session `/om` gate persisted as `om.enabled`; orchestrator-assigned unique timestamp IDs; strong default model `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6` (observer low thinking, consolidator medium); minimal `{timestamp, content, tokenCount}` observations; observers run in parallel over fixed token slices, commit via `om.observations.recorded`, and use `.memory/.runs` IPC; compaction snaps to chunk boundaries and waits only when in-flight observers could affect its projection.

Phase B design consolidates oldest observations above a pool target into `.memory/` topic files and JOURNEY.md; consolidator tools are path-scoped, with no terminal or INDEX.md writing, and on clean exit orchestrator tombstones handed observations intersected with currently active observations. INDEX.md is orchestrator-rendered; topic files and journey persist across `/tree`; compaction renders journey, live memory map, then observations.

Supplied README describes extension commands `/om`, `/om on`, `/om off`, `/om:status`, `/om:compact`, `/om:consolidate`; configurable token thresholds/models; and says Phase A+B are implemented. The supplied code/config excerpts show current defaults differing from plan/README in places: `chunkTokens: 10000` and `consolidateAtPoolTokens: 15000` in `src/config.ts`.

The supplied repository excerpts cover ledger folding/projection/progress, timestamp assignment, memory paths/index rendering, worker spawn and IPC, compaction and observer/consolidator triggers, UI status gauges and timeline, and focused Vitest suites. They are reference context only; no implementation or test execution was requested in this historical packet.
